findings.why: The request is for service parts. The only approval found (AP-0311) is for BR-220 at TO1 for STL, and the approved list does not cover service parts. The receiving plant is not stated, and Torino Plant 3 is also out of scope. No controlled record in the documents covers BR-220 service parts, so a missing approval cannot be read as 'not approved'. A person must confirm the approval status for service parts and the receiving plant.
